stage: initial reproducible study; human image audit and campus validation pending
primary_selection_metric: validation macro F1 across all six fixed labels
test_policy: Freeze selected checkpoints and deployment choice before test evaluation. No test-guided changes.
augmentation: training only: horizontal flip p=0.5, rotation +/-10 degrees with white fill, brightness and contrast +/-0.1
mobilenet: torchvision MobileNetV2 IMAGENET1K_V2; frozen backbone including batchnorm; dropout 0.2 and six-class linear head
cnn: three conv-ReLU-maxpool blocks 16/32/64 channels; adaptive 4x4 pool; dropout 0.3; six-class linear head
weighting_ablation: small CNN only; weighted vs unweighted cross entropy using same seed, initialization, split, optimizer, augmentation, epoch budget and stopping rule
uncertainty: 2000 paired group-bootstrap samples of test predictions for descriptive 95% intervals; resample near-duplicate groups together
claim_limit: One seed and one dataset split. Descriptive comparisons do not establish statistical significance or campus accuracy.
